solution_steps: Summon '''Decayed Commander''' face up attack position.
Activiate '''Decayed Commander''' special effect to summon '''Zombie Tiger''' from your hand to the field.
Activate Zombie Tiger's special effect, equip to Decayed Commander.
Attack Vorse Raider with Giant Rat. Activate special effect. Summon Milus Radiant from your deck.
Have Decayed Commander attack Vorse Raider. Have Milus Radiant attack LP directly.
